557:t_025:9.en:
$$レナード$$
(That my mother... denied my very existence...)

557:t_025:11.en:
$$宗介$$
(I don't understand what it means, but the Captain was right. He's shaken.)

557:t_025:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「Do you think I'd say that if I were making it up?」

557:t_025:14.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Knowing that, why... can she get in my way...?」

557:t_025:15.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$テレサ$$ is twisted...! She's abnormal! So she's that woman's daughter after all!」

557:t_025:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「No... Don't screw with me! Enough of this bullshit!!」

557:t_026:4.en:
$$宗介$$
(Hold on, I'm coming...! Even if the future waiting for me makes that impossible, I'll keep moving...!)

557:t_026:5.en:
$$宗介$$
(That will itself must have meaning...!)

557:t_026:6.en:
$$宗介$$
(I'm no longer a machine that kills whoever it's told to! I'm a human who worries, hesitates... and decides...!)

557:t_026:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's too late. The world's transformation is about to begin.」

557:t_026:8.en:
$$レナード$$
「I can feel it. Even at this very moment, I can see multiple worlds overlapping.」

557:t_026:9.en:
$$レナード$$
「Every conceivable possibility... is moving toward the past...」

557:t_026:10.en:
$$レナード$$
「The world is beginning to change. You can't perceive it.」

557:t_026:11.en:
$$レナード$$
「But don't despair. Everything will get better.」

557:t_026:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Do you understand? She'll make everything better.」

557:t_026:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「Out of my way, $$レナード$$!」

557:t_027:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's over, $$相良$$! I'll crush your cockpit!」

557:t_030:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$アーマー…マグナム$$...」

557:t_030:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I borrowed it from $$キリコ$$, along with the tactic. Your machine can't deploy its $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ anymore.」

557:t_031:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't move. You have no strength left to fight.」

557:t_031:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「...I never thought... I'd fall for a trick like that at the very end...」

557:t_032:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Yes... That talk about $$テレサ$$ seems to have hit me harder than I expected.」

557:t_032:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「She... knew about Mom... and still could do this...」

557:t_032:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「I thought she was my helpless little sister... a fool. But she's far tougher than I am...」

557:t_032:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「...I don't really understand. I... had grown sick of everything.」

557:t_032:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「For a long time, everything seemed worthless, and everyone seemed like an idiot...」

557:t_032:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「I know that's abnormal. That's why I wanted to be normal.」

557:t_032:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「I thought this was the only way to become normal.」

557:t_032:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I want to be normal, too... I've always felt that way.」

557:t_032:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「...At last, we understand each other a little... Now we'll die while nurturing a friendship...」

557:t_032:13.en:
$$レナード$$
「Do you think that's how this ends?」

557:t_033:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「The $$時空震動弾$$'s detonation switch. In ten minutes, a twenty-kilometer radius around these $$第３新東京市$$ ruins will be caught in the transfer.」

557:t_033:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「I don't know why, but the world's transformation has stopped... So this is just a self-destruct switch now.」

557:t_033:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「While I'm at it... I'll blow up $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$, too, and $$千鳥かなめ$$...」

557:t_035:1.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「We cannot lose that girl.」

557:t_035:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Major! You still haven't given up on the plan!?」

557:t_035:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「$n! I'm counting on you to look after $$千鳥$$!」

557:t_035:13.en:
$n
「What are you talking about!? The $$時空震動弾$$ will activate any minute!」

557:t_035:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「But if I don't stop the Major here, $$千鳥$$ will be targeted again!」

557:t_035:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll come back, no matter what...」

557:t_035:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then let's go home. To our classroom.」
